title: Restore Fee Courtesy Rates on Domain Registrations
content:
## Restore fee courtesy terms — Domain Registrations

The restore fee charged on a redemption restore of a Domain Registrations domain billed on or after 1 December 2025 is set by the domain's own restore and redemption records, in three tiers.

**Clause.** The restore fee is waived, nothing being charged, where the domain's most recent restore charge carries a price-match refund, that is a refund line returning part but not all of that charge; where no such price-match refund stands and the restore is made within 10 calendar days after the date the domain entered redemption, the fee is the lower of the TLD's restore fee and USD 49.00; where no such price-match refund stands and the restore is made later, the fee is the TLD's restore fee.

The restore fee of a redemption restore is fixed only after the domain's most recent restore charge, where it was billed from 1 January 2022 through 30 November 2025 by card or PayPal and earns Domain Care credits, carries its price-match refund.

| Records show | Restore fee on this restore |
|---|---|
| The most recent restore charge on the domain has a refund line against it returning part, but not all, of that charge | Waived: USD 0.00 |
| No such refund line; the restore falls on or before the 10th calendar day after the redemption date | The lower of the TLD's restore fee and USD 49.00 |
| No such refund line; the restore falls on the 11th calendar day after the redemption date or later | The TLD's restore fee |

### Points of judgement
- **What counts as a price-match refund.** Only a refund line that returns part of the most recent restore charge. A refund line returning the whole charge, or no refund line at all, is not a price-match refund, and the fee then follows the day count.
- **Counting the days.** The day after the date the domain entered redemption is day 1. A restore on day 10 is within the 10 calendar days; a restore on day 11 is not.
- **The lower of two figures.** Where the TLD's restore fee is itself USD 49.00 or less, the early tier charges that restore fee; where it is higher, the early tier charges USD 49.00.

*Hypothetical case (figures chosen for illustration, not a TLD's price):* a domain whose TLD restore fee were USD 120.00 entered redemption on 3 May 2029 and has no refund line on its most recent restore charge. Restored on 13 May 2029 (day 10), the fee is USD 49.00; restored on 14 May 2029 (day 11), the fee is USD 120.00.
